experiment_data.hypothesis: Expanding DocRED BCS-controlled batches from 5 to 15 per count level will narrow the factorial interaction CI (currently [-1.6, 13.0]) sufficiently to resolve whether the BCS-count interaction is bounded or substantial in document-level RE. If the CI narrows to exclude zero, the interaction is genuine and non-additive; if it narrows to include zero tightly, the bounded-interaction claim strengthens.
